newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks mixed amid bank, industry sales.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks mixed amid bank, industry sales.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed on Monday in sessions that were marked by sales in bank and manufacturing shares, brokers said.

Bogota's IBB ended unchanged from Friday's close, ending at 838.24 on a 1.28 billion peso trade. Medellin's IBOMED general price index drifted down 0.3 percent to 13,207.16 on volume of 868.7 million pesos.
"Foreign funds are maintaining their interest. Some of the cement mnanufacturers are getting more difficult to sell because of the expectation of poor year-end results," one Bogota broker said.
Banco Industrial Colombiano dropped back 2.94 percent to 3,300 in a 151 million peso trade.

In the Bogota exchange Banco Ganadero rose 2.43 percent to 252 in a 235 million peso volume while Bancoquia climbed 0.71 percent to 1,700 in a 49 million peso volume. Supermarket chain Cadenalco ended 1.25 percent up at 810 in a 62 million peso volume.

"Banco Ganadero recovered from the relative sluggishness of recent weeks and saw some demand on Wall Street, where it also quoted. Moreover, it's good for speculating because it's easy to sell," another broker said.
"Rises in Bancoquia and Cadenalco were the result of price corrections although the bulk of deals were at less than 800 pesos per share," the broker added.
Brewing giant Bavaria fell 1.58 percent to 4,035 in a 188 million peso volume.

On the Medellin exchange, Bavaria gained 0.11 percent ending at 4,050 in a 229 million peso volume. There were also various cross-deals in cigarette manufacturer Coltabaco, which remained unchanged at 3,000, and in cement manufacturer Cementos Paz del Rio, which fell 2.22 percent to 880 in a 184 million peso volume.
